files.README.md:
# Staveley Dental - patient information pack

Front-desk reference pack. The pack is written in numbered sections, one file per section, and the section list in pack/index.txt is authoritative. Cross-references always cite the section number and the cited section must exist.
files.pack/appointments.md:
# Section 1 Appointments

## Booking

Appointments can be booked by phone or at the desk; reminders go out 2 days ahead.

## Cancellation

Cancellations inside 24 hours may incur the missed-slot fee.
files.pack/hygiene-services.md:
# Section 3 Hygiene services

## Examination

The routine examination includes two bitewing radiographs a year.

## Scale and polish

The scale-and-polish visit starts from 65; the hygienist confirms the tier on the day.

## Whitening

Whitening prices are set out in Section 4, 'Whitening and cosmetic tariffs'.
